yacl3.config.windy:config.spawnWind.desc:
Controls whether wind particles can spawn in the world.

Default: §aYes
yacl3.config.windy:config.minimumWindHei:
The minimum height at which wind particles can spawn.

Default: 83
yacl3.config.windy:config.windMustSeeSky:
Controls whether wind particles can only spawn in locations with sky access.

Default: §aYes
Controls how frequently wind particles spawn.

Default: 1.0%
